newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel shares ahead as trading resumes.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel shares ahead as trading resumes.

text.p: Shares in troubled channel tunnel operator Eurotunnel opened higher on Tuesday as trading resumed after yesterday's multi-billion pound debt restructuring.
Suspended a week ago at 113-1/2p, Eurotunnel shares were trading up 7-1/2p at 121p shortly after the opening.
Dealings in Eurotunnel shares were suspended on September 30 to avoid "speculation" as the group negotiated the restructuring of 8.7 billion stg of debt with its bankers.
Yesterday it unveiled plans which will wipe out one billion stg of debt and give the banks a 45.5 percent stake in the company.
The deal means Eurotunnel will trim its annual interest bill and, it hopes, give it the financial stability to consolidate its commercial position over the medium term.
The deal has still to be approved by Eurotunnel shareholders and ratified by the 225 members of the banking syndicate.
